intent: The machine answers a binary choice and shows how sure it is: SIM and NÃO are two product options on one list, and the gold probability bar fills toward SIM.
hero: sim_fill — the gold #F4B400 probability bar inside the SIM track (592 px / 74% of the 800 px track at the cut); every other element only frames it

objects.drift: same spline, no second move: f30 0.729 -> f39 0.740 (= 8.8 px of width over the last 9 frames; f32 -> f39 alone is +6.0 px). Leading edge x: f11 412 / f17 620 / f23 702 / f32 726 / f39 732, so 208 px of empty track remains at the cut and the bar is still visibly creeping when the beat ends. Also inherits the row's shared scale/ty spline (below)
objects.enter: leaves the gate at f5 with width 0 (0.0% of the 800 px track) — opacity rides the SIM row (0 at f0 -> 1 at f4), transform-origin (140, 746). ONE monotone spline, (frame, fraction of track): f5 0.012 / f11 0.340 / f17 0.600 / f23 0.702 / f30 0.729 / f39 0.740. Fast out of the gate (274 px of width in 6 frames = 45 px/frame), then a long deceleration — no hit, no stop
objects.exit: held to cut — dry cut into palco B (u04); no exit animation, width velocity still positive at f39
objects.notes: x = left edge (flush with the track's left end), y = top edge. 592 px of travel is the 1/3-rule-safe case: it is an area change broken by 5 intermediate control points, not a slide. Never separates from sim_meter — the fill is clipped by the pill's inner radius, radius 46
objects.what: gold #F4B400 probability pill (radius 46) growing from the left end of the SIM track, with a white #FFFFFF @22% gloss band across its top 34 px clipped to the pill radius so the leading edge reads as a lit surface

objects.drift: the same spline keeps travelling: scale f14 1.004 / f26 1.007 / f39 1.011 and group ty f0 +34 / f8 +6 / f14 0 / f24 -5 / f39 -11 px (monotone, no reversal). f32 -> f39 the track gains ~2.2 px of width and rises 3.4 px — measurable on a still diff, invisible as a jump
objects.enter: shares the transform of the SIM row group (this track + sim_label + the fill): group ty starts 34 px BELOW rest (f0) and opacity 0 -> 1 over f0..f4; scale 0.930 -> 1.000, transform-origin (140, 746) = the track's left-centre, ONE spline f0 0.930 / f6 1.015 / f9 0.998 / f14 1.004 (3.2% overshoot, 6 frames wide, no hold at either end)
objects.exit: held to cut; the empty remainder of the track (x 732 -> 940) is the only quiet ink mass in the frame and nothing animates on it independently

objects.what: SIM probability track: full pill 800 x 92, radius 46, ink #1C1A18 @12% alpha over the cream (an alpha of an allowed colour, no new hue), holding the gold fill flush at its left end

objects.drift: continues on the identical spline: scale f14 1.004 / f26 1.007 / f39 1.011, ty +34 -> -11 px. Nothing about the label is keyframed separately — entrance and drift are the same control-point list
objects.enter: one of the two elements of the SIM row group: enters from 34 px below rest with the group, opacity 0 -> 1 over f0..f4, same scale spline f0 0.930 / f6 1.015 / f9 0.998 around the shared origin (140, 746). The label therefore sweeps 340 px x 6% = ~20 px on entry, then settles into the same curve
objects.notes: x = left edge, y = top of the 148 px em box; cap top = y+36 (f572), baseline = y+116 (f652). Label baseline (652) to track top (700) = 48 px, a product-UI label/field rhythm, not a poster gap
objects.what: the word SIM in Hetrixo ExtraBold uppercase, 148 px, ink #1C1A18, tracking +0.02em, left-aligned; read as a product option label, not a display word

objects.enter: the NÃO row group (this label + nao_meter + nao_fill) enters exactly 6 frames behind SIM: opacity 0 until f6 then 0 -> 1 by f11 (the f0..f6 opacity 0 is absence, not a hold), scale 0.930 -> 1.000 with transform-origin (140, 1084) = the NÃO track's left-centre, ONE spline f6 0.930 / f10 1.014 / f13 0.999 / f18 1.004

objects.enter: rides the NÃO row group: opacity 0 -> 1 over f6..f11, scale spline from f6 (0.930 -> 1.014 -> 0.999 -> 1.004) around origin (140, 1084)

objects.what: NÃO track: pill 800 x 72, radius 36, the same ink @12% alpha, empty of any fill until the muted echo arrives; shorter than the SIM pill so the two rows read at different weights

objects.drift: still growing at the cut: f30 0.095 -> f39 0.115 = 16 px of width over the last 9 frames (f32 -> f39 alone is +12 px), plus the NÃO row's scale/ty spline and the 2 px lag
objects.enter: a late echo of the hero: opacity 0 until f19 then 0 -> 1 by f22; width leaves 0 at f19, ONE spline f19 0 / f24 0.055 / f30 0.095 / f39 0.115 (x 800 px = 92 px at the cut)
objects.notes: x = left edge, y = top edge. Deliberately low contrast: muted at full alpha on a 12% ink track, capped at 1/8 of the track, so it never pulls the eye off the gold. It completes the read ('both options carry a probability, one dominates') without introducing a new idea after the midpoint
objects.what: the small counter-probability bar: muted #5A544E pill (radius 36) inside the NÃO track, the losing option's probability

objects.drift: scaleX f22 1.003 / f39 1.006 (= 2.4 px of growth over the tail) plus the shared group ty (+34 -> -11 px); at the cut the hairline is still expanding imperceptibly
objects.enter: draws itself from its left end: opacity 0 until f9 then 0 -> 1 by f12; scaleX 0 -> 1 with transform-origin x=140, ONE spline f9 0 / f13 1.020 / f16 0.998 / f22 1.003 — the rule snaps across in 7 frames and keeps breathing instead of landing dead
objects.notes: y=840 sits 48 px under the SIM pill and 75 px over the NÃO cap top — it sequences the read (SIM row, fold, NÃO row) and is the reason the two rows read as one component rather than two badges
objects.what: a 2 px ink #1C1A18 @10% alpha hairline rule spanning the panel between the two options — the fold of the list, not a card border; no text

internal_beats.event: SIM row appears 34 px below its rest position, opacity 0 -> 1, scale from 0.930 around (140, 746); the panel is rising before it is legible
gold fill leaves the gate (width departs 0) — the beat's only event; group ty is at ~+14 px
NÃO row begins its entrance, 6 frames behind SIM (opacity 0 -> 1, scale from 0.930)
hairline rule starts drawing from x=140; fill is at 0.24 of the track (192 px)
fill at 0.340 (272 px) — the fast phase is over, deceleration starts
NÃO row lands (scale 0.998, opacity 1); fill at 0.40 — the binary pair is complete and the panel reads instantly
rule reaches full width; group ty = 0, the panel has arrived at rest — and immediately keeps going (same spline)
muted NÃO fill departs 0, the quiet echo of the hero on the losing option
fill passes 0.70 (560 px); the deceleration is unmistakable — the meter is settling on its answer
group ty crosses into negative (-5 px): the panel is now drifting upward on the same spline that brought it in
last new idea is already on screen; only drift remains — fill 0.7325 (586 px), ty -7.6 px, NÃO fill 76 px
cut. fill 0.740 (592 px, leading edge x=732), 208 px of empty track, group ty -11 px, NÃO fill 92 px, rule +2.4 px wider — every element still moving, nothing frozen, nothing new

sfx_cues.why: The gold probability bar is the only event in this 1.33 s beat, and the brief itself pairs this beat with a riser. A short riser (f3 -> f13, ~10 frames) tracks the fill's fast phase (f5 -> f11, 274 px of width in 6 frames) and decays into the NÃO row landing at f12 without a hit, so the fill gets a body instead of the cut being decorated. Everything else (SIM panel, rule, muted echo) stays silent — per BEHAVIORS.md the canvas is silent by default and support text earns no pop.

risks: Two stacked rows plus a rule is a lot of surface for 40 frames. It reads because SIM is 148 px ink + gold and NÃO is 112 px muted with no early fill; if the preview reads busy, delete nao_fill first (the empty NÃO track still reads as the losing option), not the row itself.

Content sits y=536..1120, leaving the caption band y=1500..1750 with 380 px of clearance. If the caption agent's P6 serif lands higher than y=1500, the NÃO pill (bottom 1120) gets crowded — do not raise the panel above y=500 for that reason.

The empty top (y=80..536) is deliberate negative space; the Reels platform UI eats y<250, so it reads centred. If the render looks top-light, translate the whole panel +40 px down as a group — every spline here is relative, so nothing else changes.

Ink @12% over cream is only ~6% of luminance separation. Verify the track survives ProRes 4444 -> 709; if it disappears on the phone screen, raise to 16% (still an alpha of an allowed colour, no new hue).

The fill decelerates hard by design (592 px total, only 8.8 px of it in the tail). If a reviewer calls the bar 'stopped', widen the tail control points (f30 0.729 -> 0.722, f39 0.740 -> 0.755) rather than adding a second move — a second spline would be exactly the enter-then-stop jerk that is banned.

nao_fill starting at f19 is the only idea that begins after the midpoint; it is capped at 1/8 of the track and kept muted so it does not compete. If it draws the eye at the cut, remove it — the SIM fill alone still carries the probability read.
No brand PNG in this beat, so no shine and no logo-animation technique applies — the u04/u05/u12 logo rules do not transfer here.

All control points above are (frame, value) pairs for a single monotone Fritsch-Carlson spline per property, sampled per frame — entrance and drift must be authored as one list, never as an ease-in followed by a separate ambient loop.
